## Overview

This is a sample project showcasing how to include data analysis work in your website.

## Data Analysis

Once you have R packages installed, you can add code like this:

````markdown
```{r}
#| echo: true
library(ggplot2)

# Summary statistics
summary(mtcars[, c("mpg", "hp", "wt")])
```
````

## Visualization

Here's an example of creating a visualization:

````markdown
```{r}
#| echo: true
library(ggplot2)

# Create a scatter plot
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg, color = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(title = "Fuel Efficiency vs. Weight",
       x = "Weight (1000 lbs)",
       y = "Miles per Gallon",
       color = "Cylinders") +
  theme_minimal()
```
````

## Conclusion

This demonstrates how you can integrate R code, analysis, and visualizations directly into your project pages.
